description:
In Season 16 of Gold Rush, the crews face a tough season filled with pressure, rough ground, flooding, and constant challenges that test their ability to keep gold production moving forward. Because of that, Parker pushes for big gold totals and record-breaking results while managing a high-pressure operation, Tony deals with flooding and difficult conditions but keeps his large mining setup running, Kevin works on building a stronger, more efficient crew for steadier production, and Rick Ness focuses on rebuilding his operation and slowly improving his gold recovery and stability. In the end, the season raises the question of how each crew finished with their total gold counts and who succeeded or fell short.
